aux_fields.n_arms: recorded arm count; arms/q/Q are padded beyond it (arms pad -2, q/priors pad 0, Q pad NaN)
aux_fields.priors: P_A, the candidate prior q is built from (C arm q0 prop. to P_A**0.5)

per_root_fields: root belief condition (belief code + n_unknown per root)

sampling.rule: pass A: game drawn w.p. pi0 (all roots); pass B: each root of an undrawn game drawn w.p. pi1; pi = pi0 + (1-pi0)*pi1
